parsed.title: Premium Insights Unlock
parsed.oneLiner: Unlock exclusive in-depth news analysis by playing a quick game.

newMechanic.name: Premium Insights
newMechanic.description: Curated in-depth investigative journalism articles which are locked behind an ad-watch gate.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: To provide high-quality gated content as a new ad-supported product tier, creating a value-exchange for non-paying users.

parsed.trigger: User taps an article in the feed marked 'Premium Insight'.

offer.title: Unlock Premium Insight
offer.body: Play a 15-second game to access this in-depth investigative article.

parsed.cannibalizationGuard: Content access is rate-limited to 3 articles per day. No paid subscription exists currently to cannibalize; this builds the habit for future monetization.
risks: Low ad fill rate in certain geographies.
Potential user friction if premium labels are not clearly distinguished from free articles.

evidence.quote: Tiffani Thiessen says a former resident still live

newScreens.change: Modal to unlock premium content for the user.

newElements.change: Play button to initiate rewarded ad.

callouts.text: User browses normal articles in the Home News Feed.

storyboard.caption: The Home News Feed displays standard news content.

callouts.text: A new 'Premium' tag identifies exclusive in-depth insights.

storyboard.caption: Curated premium articles are introduced to the feed.

callouts.text: Play a quick game to unlock this premium content.

storyboard.caption: An overlay invites the user to play for access.

callouts.text: The user plays the branded mini-game with AOL News.

storyboard.caption: Content is now unlocked and readable.
